name: Bug
about: An ois command crashes, writes something wrong, or reports something the specification does not say
title: ""
labels: bug
---

## Version and command

Output of `ois --version` and the exact command you ran, for example `ois validate …`.

## Input

The smallest document, record, YAML file or JUnit XML report that shows it. Remove anything
confidential.

## What happened and what you expected

The reports or error you got, and the reports the specification or a conformance fixture
leads you to expect.
